Canadian Snowbirds Jet Fleet Grounded Until 2030s

Canada's iconic Snowbirds aerobatic team has grounded its CT-114 Tutor jets, with the fleet expected to remain out of service until the 2030s. The decision follows a recent incident involving one of the jets, though details of the specific incident were not provided in the coverage. The grounding marks a significant pause for the team, known for its aerial displays across Canada. This period will be a bittersweet farewell for the team and its supporters, as the jets will not fly for the foreseeable future.
